newsitem.title: USA: Diana stake cut by investor.
newsitem.headline: Diana stake cut by investor.

text.p: Richard Fisher, a Wisconsin investor, said Tuesday he had cut his stake in Diana Corp to 460,642 shares, or 8.3 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Fisher said his latest transactions included the sale of 400,000 shares between December 18 and January 27 at prices ranging from $15.50 to $28 per share.
Fisher sold the stock for the purpose of diversifying his investments, the filing said.
Diana Corp, based in Milwaukee, Wis., is engaged in the distribution of food and related items.
